$comment: Fixture. Deliberately fails C7 without relaxing anything. It extends the baseline and restates the inherited 'disclosure' block with a different markerPrefix. Because a derived profile's top-level keys are merged over the base's, the base's prefix is overridden silently: no override is rejected, no rule changes, and every disclosure marker written by a producer following the base would stop being recognised. Documents would then fail as undeclared with nothing in the output pointing at the cause. Not a real profile; do not copy.
title: Fixture - C7 restates an inherited block

objective.consumer: A fixture, standing in for a consumer.
objective.decision: Whether the checker catches a silently overridden inherited block.
